headline: Natural Gas Surges as Energy and Metals Post Broad Rebounds
paragraphs: Natural gas recorded the sharpest move, surging 10.86% to $3.68 per MMBtu (EUR 3.36) after a technical breakout prompted buyers to target higher price levels. Silver followed with a 2.97% gain to $41.97 per oz (EUR 38.28), attempting a recovery against key resistance hurdles following steep weekly declines.

WTI crude advanced 2.82% to $84.36 per barrel (EUR 76.94) as Middle East tensions flared following reports that Houthi forces attacked a Saudi facility. Palladium rose 2.51% to $879.50 per oz (EUR 802.19), though the specific catalyst for today's rebound after prolonged weakness is unclear.

Copper gained 2.49% to $5.50 per lb (EUR 5.01), finding support as tight physical supply helped counter recent pressure from broader economic slowdown fears. Platinum rounded out the notable movers, rising 2.16% to $1285.90 per oz (EUR 1172.87), with the exact cause for the daily upturn also unclear.
